   101	size_t chooseBlockSize(const size_t n, const ProcessGrid& grid) {
   102	    // Small cache-resident blocks give the custom kernels good locality.  At
   103	    // least four block cycles per process-grid dimension also smooth out the
   104	    // shrinking triangular workload late in the factorization.
   105	    const size_t largest_dimension =
   106	        static_cast<size_t>(std::max(grid.rows, grid.columns));
   107	    size_t block_size = n / std::max<size_t>(1, 4 * largest_dimension);
   108	    block_size = ((block_size + 8) / 16) * 16;
   109	    block_size = std::clamp<size_t>(block_size, 16, 64);
   110	    block_size = std::min(block_size, n);
   111	
   112	    // This is deliberately an environment tuning knob rather than a new CLI
   113	    // option, so the benchmark's command-line interface remains unchanged.
   114	    if (const char* value = std::getenv("CHOLESKY_BLOCK_SIZE")) {
   115	        char* end = nullptr;
   116	        errno = 0;
   117	        const unsigned long long parsed = std::strtoull(value, &end, 10);
   118	        if (errno == 0 && end != value && *end == '\0' && parsed > 0 &&
   119	            parsed <= n) {
   120	            block_size = static_cast<size_t>(parsed);
   121	        }
   122	    }
   123	    return block_size;
   124	}
   125	
   126	class DistributedLowerMatrix {
   127	  public:
   128	    DistributedLowerMatrix(const size_t matrix_size, const size_t block_size,
   129	                           const ProcessGrid& grid)
   130	        : n_(matrix_size), block_size_(block_size),
   131	          block_count_((matrix_size + block_size - 1) / block_size),
   132	          block_area_(block_size * block_size), grid_(grid),
   133	          local_index_(block_count_ * block_count_, -1) {
   134	        size_t local_blocks = 0;
   135	        for (size_t i = 0; i < block_count_; ++i) {
   136	            for (size_t j = 0; j <= i; ++j) {
   137	                if (owns(i, j)) {
   138	                    local_index_[i * block_count_ + j] =
   139	                        static_cast<long long>(local_blocks++);
   140	                }
   141	            }
   142	        }
   143	        if (local_blocks >
   144	            std::numeric_limits<size_t>::max() / block_area_) {
   145	            throw std::overflow_error("local matrix allocation is too large");
   146	        }
   147	        data_.assign(local_blocks * block_area_, 0.0);
   148	    }
   149	
   150	    size_t matrixSize() const { return n_; }
   151	    size_t blockSize() const { return block_size_; }
   152	    size_t blockCount() const { return block_count_; }
   153	    size_t blockArea() const { return block_area_; }
   154	
   155	    size_t activeSize(const size_t block) const {
   156	        return std::min(block_size_, n_ - block * block_size_);
   157	    }
   158	
   159	    bool owns(const size_t block_row, const size_t block_column) const {
   160	        return static_cast<int>(block_row % grid_.rows) ==
   161	                   grid_.row_coordinate &&
   162	               static_cast<int>(block_column % grid_.columns) ==
   163	                   grid_.column_coordinate;
   164	    }
   165	
   166	    int ownerRank(const size_t block_row, const size_t block_column) const {
   167	        int coordinates[2] = {
   168	            static_cast<int>(block_row % grid_.rows),
   169	            static_cast<int>(block_column % grid_.columns)};
   170	        int owner = -1;
   171	        mpiCheck(MPI_Cart_rank(grid_.cart, coordinates, &owner), grid_.cart,
   172	                 "MPI_Cart_rank");
   173	        return owner;
   174	    }
   175	
   176	    double* block(const size_t block_row, const size_t block_column) {
   177	        const long long local =
   178	            local_index_[block_row * block_count_ + block_column];
   179	        assert(local >= 0);
   180	        return data_.data() + static_cast<size_t>(local) * block_area_;
   180	        return data_.data() + static_cast<size_t>(local) * block_area_;
   181	    }
   182	
   183	    const double* block(const size_t block_row,
   184	                        const size_t block_column) const {
   185	        const long long local =
   186	            local_index_[block_row * block_count_ + block_column];
   187	        assert(local >= 0);
   188	        return data_.data() + static_cast<size_t>(local) * block_area_;
   189	    }
   190	
   191	    std::vector<double>& localData() { return data_; }
   192	    const std::vector<double>& localData() const { return data_; }
   193	
   194	  private:
   195	    size_t n_;
   196	    size_t block_size_;
   197	    size_t block_count_;
   198	    size_t block_area_;
   199	    const ProcessGrid& grid_;
   200	    std::vector<long long> local_index_;
   201	    std::vector<double> data_;
   202	};
   203	
   204	// Generate exactly the same rand_r stream and B*B^T matrix as the original
   205	// benchmark.  A rank only retains B rows needed by the block rows and block
   206	// columns of A that it owns.
   207	void generatePositiveDefiniteMatrix(DistributedLowerMatrix& matrix,
   208	                                    const ProcessGrid& grid) {
   209	    const size_t n = matrix.matrixSize();
   210	    const size_t block_size = matrix.blockSize();
   211	    std::vector<long long> row_offset(n, -1);
   212	    size_t needed_row_count = 0;
   213	
   214	    for (size_t row = 0; row < n; ++row) {
   215	        const size_t block = row / block_size;
   216	        const bool needed_as_left =
   217	            static_cast<int>(block % grid.rows) == grid.row_coordinate;
   218	        const bool needed_as_right =
   219	            static_cast<int>(block % grid.columns) == grid.column_coordinate;
   220	        if (needed_as_left || needed_as_right) {
   221	            row_offset[row] = static_cast<long long>(needed_row_count++);
   222	        }
   223	    }
   224	
   225	    if (needed_row_count > std::numeric_limits<size_t>::max() / n) {
   226	        throw std::overflow_error("matrix generator allocation is too large");
   227	    }
   228	    std::vector<double> needed_rows(needed_row_count * n);
   229	    unsigned int seed = 42;
   230	    for (size_t row = 0; row < n; ++row) {
   231	        double* destination = row_offset[row] >= 0
   232	                                  ? needed_rows.data() +
   233	                                        static_cast<size_t>(row_offset[row]) * n
   234	                                  : nullptr;
   235	        for (size_t column = 0; column < n; ++column) {
   236	            const double value =
   237	                (rand_r(&seed) / static_cast<double>(RAND_MAX)) - 0.5;
   238	            if (destination != nullptr) {
   239	                destination[column] = value;
   240	            }
   241	        }
   242	    }
   243	
   244	    const size_t blocks = matrix.blockCount();
   245	    for (size_t block_row = 0; block_row < blocks; ++block_row) {
   246	        for (size_t block_column = 0; block_column <= block_row;
   247	             ++block_column) {
   248	            if (!matrix.owns(block_row, block_column)) {
   249	                continue;
   250	            }
   251	            const size_t row_count = matrix.activeSize(block_row);
   252	            const size_t column_count = matrix.activeSize(block_column);
   253	            double* a = matrix.block(block_row, block_column);
   254	            for (size_t local_row = 0; local_row < row_count; ++local_row) {
   255	                const size_t global_row = block_row * block_size + local_row;
   256	                const double* left =
   257	                    needed_rows.data() +
   258	                    static_cast<size_t>(row_offset[global_row]) * n;
   259	                for (size_t local_column = 0; local_column < column_count;
   260	                     ++local_column) {
   261	                    const size_t global_column =
   262	                        block_column * block_size + local_column;
   263	                    const double* right =
   264	                        needed_rows.data() +
   265	                        static_cast<size_t>(row_offset[global_column]) * n;
   266	                    double sum = 0.0;
   267	#pragma omp simd reduction(+ : sum)
   268	                    for (size_t k = 0; k < n; ++k) {
   269	                        sum += left[k] * right[k];
   270	                    }
   271	                    if (global_row == global_column) {
   272	                        sum += static_cast<double>(n);
   273	                    }
   274	                    a[local_row * block_size + local_column] = sum;
   275	                }
   276	            }
   277	        }
   278	    }
   279	}
   280	
   281	bool factorDiagonalBlock(double* diagonal, const size_t active_size,
   282	                         const size_t stride, size_t& failed_diagonal) {
   283	    for (size_t j = 0; j < active_size; ++j) {
   284	        double value = diagonal[j * stride + j];
   285	#pragma omp simd reduction(- : value)
   286	        for (size_t k = 0; k < j; ++k) {
   287	            value -= diagonal[j * stride + k] * diagonal[j * stride + k];
   288	        }
   289	        if (!(value > 0.0) || !std::isfinite(value)) {
   290	            failed_diagonal = j;
   291	            return false;
   292	        }
   293	        diagonal[j * stride + j] = std::sqrt(value);
   294	
   295	        const double reciprocal = 1.0 / diagonal[j * stride + j];
   296	        for (size_t i = j + 1; i < active_size; ++i) {
   297	            double entry = diagonal[i * stride + j];
   298	#pragma omp simd reduction(- : entry)
   299	            for (size_t k = 0; k < j; ++k) {
   300	                entry -= diagonal[i * stride + k] *
   301	                         diagonal[j * stride + k];
   302	            }
   303	            diagonal[i * stride + j] = entry * reciprocal;
   304	        }
   305	        std::fill(diagonal + j * stride + j + 1,
   306	                  diagonal + j * stride + active_size, 0.0);
   307	    }
   308	    return true;
   309	}
   310	
   311	void solvePanelBlock(double* panel, const double* diagonal,
   312	                     const size_t panel_rows, const size_t diagonal_size,
   313	                     const size_t stride) {
   314	    for (size_t row = 0; row < panel_rows; ++row) {
   315	        double* values = panel + row * stride;
   316	        for (size_t j = 0; j < diagonal_size; ++j) {
   317	            double entry = values[j];
   318	#pragma omp simd reduction(- : entry)
   319	            for (size_t k = 0; k < j; ++k) {
   320	                entry -= values[k] * diagonal[j * stride + k];
   321	            }
   322	            values[j] = entry / diagonal[j * stride + j];
   323	        }
   324	    }
   325	}
   326	
   327	void updateTrailingBlock(double* target, const double* left,
   328	                         const double* right, const size_t target_rows,
   329	                         const size_t target_columns, const size_t panel_width,
   330	                         const size_t stride, const bool diagonal_block) {
   331	    for (size_t i = 0; i < target_rows; ++i) {
   332	        const size_t last_column =
   333	            diagonal_block ? std::min(i + 1, target_columns) : target_columns;
   334	        const double* left_row = left + i * stride;
   335	        size_t j = 0;
   336	        // Four simultaneous dot products reuse L(i,k) and substantially reduce
   337	        // load traffic without requiring an external BLAS implementation.
   338	        for (; j + 3 < last_column; j += 4) {
   339	            double value0 = target[i * stride + j];
   340	            double value1 = target[i * stride + j + 1];
   341	            double value2 = target[i * stride + j + 2];
   342	            double value3 = target[i * stride + j + 3];
   343	            const double* right0 = right + j * stride;
   344	            const double* right1 = right0 + stride;
   345	            const double* right2 = right1 + stride;
   346	            const double* right3 = right2 + stride;
   347	#pragma omp simd reduction(- : value0, value1, value2, value3)
   348	            for (size_t k = 0; k < panel_width; ++k) {
   349	                const double left_value = left_row[k];
   350	                value0 -= left_value * right0[k];
   351	                value1 -= left_value * right1[k];
   352	                value2 -= left_value * right2[k];
   353	                value3 -= left_value * right3[k];
   354	            }
   355	            target[i * stride + j] = value0;
   356	            target[i * stride + j + 1] = value1;
   357	            target[i * stride + j + 2] = value2;
   358	            target[i * stride + j + 3] = value3;
   359	        }
   360	        for (; j < last_column; ++j) {
   361	            double value = target[i * stride + j];
   362	            const double* right_row = right + j * stride;
   363	#pragma omp simd reduction(- : value)
   364	            for (size_t k = 0; k < panel_width; ++k) {
   365	                value -= left_row[k] * right_row[k];
   366	            }
   367	            target[i * stride + j] = value;
   368	        }
   369	    }
   370	}
   371	
   372	bool distributedCholesky(DistributedLowerMatrix& matrix,
   373	                         const ProcessGrid& grid,
   374	                         size_t& failed_global_diagonal) {
   375	    const size_t block_size = matrix.blockSize();
   376	    const size_t block_area = matrix.blockArea();
   377	    const size_t block_count = matrix.blockCount();
   378	
   379	    // Every process row caches the factor blocks whose block-row it owns.
   380	    const size_t row_panel_slots =
   381	        (block_count + static_cast<size_t>(grid.rows) - 1) / grid.rows;
   382	    std::vector<double> row_panel_workspace(row_panel_slots * block_area);
   383	    std::vector<double*> row_panels(block_count, nullptr);
   384	    std::vector<MPI_Request> row_requests;
   385	    row_requests.reserve(row_panel_slots);
   386	
   387	    // Double buffering overlaps the next process-column broadcast with the
   388	    // local matrix multiplication for the current trailing block column.
   389	    std::vector<double> column_workspace(2 * block_area);
   390	
   391	    for (size_t k_block = 0; k_block < block_count; ++k_block) {
   392	        const int diagonal_process_row =
   393	            static_cast<int>(k_block % grid.rows);
   394	        const int diagonal_process_column =
   395	            static_cast<int>(k_block % grid.columns);
   396	        const size_t diagonal_size = matrix.activeSize(k_block);
   397	        int factorization_ok = 1;
   398	        size_t failed_in_block = 0;
   399	
   400	        if (grid.row_coordinate == diagonal_process_row &&
   401	            grid.column_coordinate == diagonal_process_column) {
   402	            factorization_ok =
   403	                factorDiagonalBlock(matrix.block(k_block, k_block),
   404	                                    diagonal_size, block_size, failed_in_block)
   405	                    ? 1
   406	                    : 0;
   407	        }
   408	
   409	        const int diagonal_rank = matrix.ownerRank(k_block, k_block);
   410	        mpiCheck(MPI_Bcast(&factorization_ok, 1, MPI_INT, diagonal_rank,
   411	                           grid.cart),
   412	                 grid.cart, "MPI_Bcast(factorization status)");
   413	        if (!factorization_ok) {
   414	            unsigned long long failed =
   415	                static_cast<unsigned long long>(failed_in_block);
   416	            mpiCheck(MPI_Bcast(&failed, 1, MPI_UNSIGNED_LONG_LONG,
   417	                               diagonal_rank, grid.cart),
   418	                     grid.cart, "MPI_Bcast(failed diagonal)");
   419	            failed_global_diagonal =
   420	                k_block * block_size + static_cast<size_t>(failed);
   421	            return false;
   422	        }
   423	
   424	        // Broadcast L(k,k) down its process column, then solve all local
   425	        // L(i,k) blocks in that column.
   426	        if (grid.column_coordinate == diagonal_process_column) {
   427	            double* diagonal =
   428	                grid.row_coordinate == diagonal_process_row
   429	                    ? matrix.block(k_block, k_block)
   430	                    : column_workspace.data();
   430	                    : column_workspace.data();
   431	            mpiCheck(MPI_Bcast(diagonal,
   432	                               static_cast<int>(diagonal_size * block_size),
   433	                               MPI_DOUBLE, diagonal_process_row, grid.column),
   434	                     grid.column, "MPI_Bcast(diagonal block)");
   435	
   436	            for (size_t i_block = k_block + 1; i_block < block_count;
   437	                 ++i_block) {
   438	                if (static_cast<int>(i_block % grid.rows) ==
   439	                    grid.row_coordinate) {
   440	                    solvePanelBlock(matrix.block(i_block, k_block), diagonal,
   441	                                    matrix.activeSize(i_block), diagonal_size,
   442	                                    block_size);
   443	                }
   444	            }
   445	        }
   446	
   447	        if (k_block + 1 == block_count) {
   448	            continue;
   449	        }
   450	
   451	        std::fill(row_panels.begin(), row_panels.end(), nullptr);
   452	        row_requests.clear();
   453	
   454	        // Broadcast all newly solved L(i,k) blocks across their process rows.
   455	        // Nonblocking collectives allow MPI to schedule the independent panel
   456	        // transfers together.
   457	        for (size_t i_block = k_block + 1; i_block < block_count; ++i_block) {
   458	            if (static_cast<int>(i_block % grid.rows) != grid.row_coordinate) {
   459	                continue;
   460	            }
   461	            double* panel = nullptr;
   462	            if (grid.column_coordinate == diagonal_process_column) {
   463	                panel = matrix.block(i_block, k_block);
   464	            } else {
   465	                const size_t slot = i_block / static_cast<size_t>(grid.rows);
   466	                panel = row_panel_workspace.data() + slot * block_area;
   467	            }
   468	            row_panels[i_block] = panel;
   469	            MPI_Request request = MPI_REQUEST_NULL;
   470	            mpiCheck(MPI_Ibcast(
   471	                         panel,
   472	                         static_cast<int>(matrix.activeSize(i_block) *
   473	                                          block_size),
   474	                         MPI_DOUBLE, diagonal_process_column, grid.row,
   475	                         &request),
   476	                     grid.row, "MPI_Ibcast(panel row)");
   477	            row_requests.push_back(request);
   478	        }
   479	        if (!row_requests.empty()) {
   480	            mpiCheck(MPI_Waitall(static_cast<int>(row_requests.size()),
   481	                                 row_requests.data(), MPI_STATUSES_IGNORE),
   482	                     grid.row, "MPI_Waitall(panel rows)");
   483	        }
   484	
   485	        // Each process column receives the L(j,k) blocks for its local block
   486	        // columns.  Pipeline those broadcasts with local GEMM/SYRK updates.
   487	        std::vector<size_t> local_block_columns;
   488	        for (size_t j_block = k_block + 1; j_block < block_count; ++j_block) {
   489	            if (static_cast<int>(j_block % grid.columns) ==
   490	                grid.column_coordinate) {
   491	                local_block_columns.push_back(j_block);
   492	            }
   493	        }
   494	
   495	        MPI_Request column_request = MPI_REQUEST_NULL;
   496	        double* broadcast_buffers[2] = {nullptr, nullptr};
   497	        auto startColumnBroadcast = [&](const size_t j_block,
   498	                                        const int slot) {
   499	            const int root = static_cast<int>(j_block % grid.rows);
   500	            broadcast_buffers[slot] =
   501	                grid.row_coordinate == root
   502	                    ? row_panels[j_block]
   503	                    : column_workspace.data() +
   504	                          static_cast<size_t>(slot) * block_area;
   505	            mpiCheck(MPI_Ibcast(
   506	                         broadcast_buffers[slot],
   507	                         static_cast<int>(matrix.activeSize(j_block) *
   508	                                          block_size),
   509	                         MPI_DOUBLE, root, grid.column, &column_request),
   510	                     grid.column, "MPI_Ibcast(panel column)");
   511	        };
   512	
   513	        if (!local_block_columns.empty()) {
   514	            startColumnBroadcast(local_block_columns.front(), 0);
   515	        }
   516	        for (size_t column_index = 0;
   517	             column_index < local_block_columns.size(); ++column_index) {
   518	            const int slot = static_cast<int>(column_index % 2);
   519	            mpiCheck(MPI_Wait(&column_request, MPI_STATUS_IGNORE), grid.column,
   520	                     "MPI_Wait(panel column)");
   521	            if (column_index + 1 < local_block_columns.size()) {
   522	                startColumnBroadcast(local_block_columns[column_index + 1],
   523	                                     1 - slot);
   524	            }
   525	
   526	            const size_t j_block = local_block_columns[column_index];
   527	            const double* right = broadcast_buffers[slot];
   528	            for (size_t i_block = j_block; i_block < block_count; ++i_block) {
   529	                if (static_cast<int>(i_block % grid.rows) !=
   530	                    grid.row_coordinate) {
   531	                    continue;
   532	                }
   533	                updateTrailingBlock(
   534	                    matrix.block(i_block, j_block), row_panels[i_block], right,
   535	                    matrix.activeSize(i_block), matrix.activeSize(j_block),
   536	                    diagonal_size, block_size, i_block == j_block);
   537	            }
   538	        }
   539	    }
   540	    return true;
   541	}
   542	
   543	std::vector<double> gatherMatrix(const DistributedLowerMatrix& matrix,
   544	                                 const ProcessGrid& grid,
   545	                                 const bool symmetric) {
   546	    const size_t local_values = matrix.localData().size();
   547	    int local_count_ok =
   548	        local_values <= static_cast<size_t>(std::numeric_limits<int>::max());
   549	    int all_counts_ok = 0;
   550	    mpiCheck(MPI_Allreduce(&local_count_ok, &all_counts_ok, 1, MPI_INT,
   551	                           MPI_LAND, grid.cart),
   552	             grid.cart, "MPI_Allreduce(gather sizes)");
   553	    if (!all_counts_ok) {
   554	        if (grid.rank == 0) {
   555	            std::fprintf(stderr,
   556	                         "Cannot gather matrix: an MPI count exceeds INT_MAX\n");
   557	        }
   558	        MPI_Abort(grid.cart, EXIT_FAILURE);
   559	    }
   560	
   561	    const int local_count = static_cast<int>(local_values);
   562	    std::vector<int> counts(grid.rank == 0 ? grid.size : 0);
   563	    mpiCheck(MPI_Gather(&local_count, 1, MPI_INT,
   564	                        grid.rank == 0 ? counts.data() : nullptr, 1, MPI_INT, 0,
   565	                        grid.cart),
   566	             grid.cart, "MPI_Gather(block counts)");
   567	
   568	    std::vector<int> displacements;
   569	    std::vector<double> packed;
   570	    if (grid.rank == 0) {
   571	        displacements.resize(grid.size);
   572	        size_t total = 0;
   573	        for (int process = 0; process < grid.size; ++process) {
   574	            if (total >
   575	                static_cast<size_t>(std::numeric_limits<int>::max())) {
   576	                std::fprintf(stderr,
   577	                             "Cannot gather matrix: total MPI count exceeds "
   578	                             "INT_MAX\n");
   579	                MPI_Abort(grid.cart, EXIT_FAILURE);
   580	            }
   581	            displacements[process] = static_cast<int>(total);
   582	            total += static_cast<size_t>(counts[process]);
   583	        }
   584	        if (total > static_cast<size_t>(std::numeric_limits<int>::max())) {
   585	            std::fprintf(stderr,
   586	                         "Cannot gather matrix: total MPI count exceeds "
   587	                         "INT_MAX\n");
   588	            MPI_Abort(grid.cart, EXIT_FAILURE);
   589	        }
   590	        packed.resize(total);
   591	    }
   592	
   593	    mpiCheck(MPI_Gatherv(
   594	                 matrix.localData().data(), local_count, MPI_DOUBLE,
   595	                 grid.rank == 0 ? packed.data() : nullptr,
   596	                 grid.rank == 0 ? counts.data() : nullptr,
   597	                 grid.rank == 0 ? displacements.data() : nullptr, MPI_DOUBLE, 0,
   598	                 grid.cart),
   599	             grid.cart, "MPI_Gatherv(matrix blocks)");
   600	
   601	    std::vector<double> result;
   602	    if (grid.rank != 0) {
   603	        return result;
   604	    }
   605	
   606	    const size_t n = matrix.matrixSize();
   607	    const size_t block_size = matrix.blockSize();
   608	    const size_t block_area = matrix.blockArea();
   609	    result.assign(n * n, 0.0);
   610	    std::vector<size_t> cursors(grid.size);
   611	    for (int process = 0; process < grid.size; ++process) {
   612	        cursors[process] = static_cast<size_t>(displacements[process]);
   613	    }
   614	
   615	    for (size_t block_row = 0; block_row < matrix.blockCount(); ++block_row) {
   616	        for (size_t block_column = 0; block_column <= block_row;
   617	             ++block_column) {
   618	            const int owner = matrix.ownerRank(block_row, block_column);
   619	            const double* block = packed.data() + cursors[owner];
   620	            cursors[owner] += block_area;
   621	            const size_t row_count = matrix.activeSize(block_row);
   622	            const size_t column_count = matrix.activeSize(block_column);
   623	            for (size_t i = 0; i < row_count; ++i) {
   624	                const size_t global_i = block_row * block_size + i;
   625	                for (size_t j = 0; j < column_count; ++j) {
   626	                    const size_t global_j = block_column * block_size + j;
   627	                    const double value = block[i * block_size + j];
   628	                    result[global_i * n + global_j] = value;
   629	                    if (symmetric && block_row != block_column) {
   630	                        result[global_j * n + global_i] = value;
   631	                    }
   632	                }
   633	            }
   634	        }
   635	    }
   636	    return result;
   637	}
   638	
   639	bool validateCholesky(const std::vector<double>& lower,
   640	                      const std::vector<double>& original, const size_t n) {
   641	    double max_error = 0.0;
   642	    double relative_error = 0.0;
   643	    for (size_t i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
   644	        for (size_t j = 0; j < n; ++j) {
   645	            double reconstructed = 0.0;
   646	            const size_t terms = std::min(i, j) + 1;
   647	            for (size_t k = 0; k < terms; ++k) {
   648	                reconstructed += lower[i * n + k] * lower[j * n + k];
   649	            }
   650	            const double reference = original[i * n + j];
   651	            const double error = std::fabs(reconstructed - reference);
   652	            max_error = std::max(max_error, error);
   653	            relative_error =
   654	                std::max(relative_error,
   655	                         error / (std::fabs(reference) + 1.0e-10));
   656	        }
   657	    }
   658	
   659	    std::printf("Max absolute error: %.10e\n", max_error);
   660	    std::printf("Max relative error: %.10e\n", relative_error);
   661	    if (relative_error > 1.0e-6) {
   662	        std::printf("Validation failed: relative error too large\n");
   663	        return false;
   664	    }
   665	    return true;
   666	}

   668	void printUsage(const char* program_name) {
   669	    std::printf("Usage: %s [options]\n", program_name);
   670	    std::printf("Options:\n");
   671	    std::printf("  -n <num>     Matrix size (default: 512)\n");
   672	    std::printf("  -v           Enable validation\n");
   673	    std::printf("  -r           Print results for external validation\n");
   674	    std::printf("  -h           Show this help message\n");
   675	}
   676	
   677	struct Options {
   678	    size_t n = 512;
   679	    bool validate = false;
   680	    bool print_results = false;
   681	    bool help = false;
   682	    bool valid = true;
   683	    std::string error;
   684	};
   685	
   686	Options parseOptions(const int argc, char** argv) {
   687	    Options options;
   688	    for (int i = 1; i < argc; ++i) {
   689	        if (std::strcmp(argv[i], "-n") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {
   690	            char* end = nullptr;
   691	            errno = 0;
   692	            const unsigned long long value = std::strtoull(argv[++i], &end, 10);
   693	            if (errno != 0 || end == argv[i] || *end != '\0' || value == 0 ||
   694	                value > std::numeric_limits<size_t>::max()) {
   695	                options.valid = false;
   696	                options.error = "Invalid matrix size: " + std::string(argv[i]);
   697	                return options;
   698	            }
   699	            options.n = static_cast<size_t>(value);
   700	        } else if (std::strcmp(argv[i], "-v") == 0) {
   701	            options.validate = true;
   702	        } else if (std::strcmp(argv[i], "-r") == 0) {
   703	            options.print_results = true;
   704	        } else if (std::strcmp(argv[i], "-h") == 0) {
   705	            options.help = true;
   706	        } else {
   707	            options.valid = false;
   708	            options.error = "Unknown option: " + std::string(argv[i]);
   709	            return options;
   710	        }
   711	    }
   712	    if (options.n > std::numeric_limits<size_t>::max() / options.n) {
   713	        options.valid = false;
   714	        options.error = "Matrix size is too large";
   715	    }
   716	    return options;
   717	}

   723	    if (init_error != MPI_SUCCESS) {

   725	        return EXIT_FAILURE;
   726	    }
   727	
   728	    ProcessGrid grid = createProcessGrid();
   729	    const Options options = parseOptions(argc, argv);
   730	    if (!options.valid || options.help) {
   731	        if (grid.rank == 0) {
   732	            if (!options.valid) {
   733	                std::printf("%s\n", options.error.c_str());
   734	            }
   735	            printUsage(argv[0]);
   736	        }
   737	        destroyProcessGrid(grid);
   738	        MPI_Finalize();
   739	        return options.valid ? EXIT_SUCCESS : EXIT_FAILURE;
   740	    }
   741	
   742	    const size_t block_size = chooseBlockSize(options.n, grid);
   743	    if (block_size > static_cast<size_t>(std::sqrt(
   744	                         static_cast<double>(std::numeric_limits<int>::max())))) {

   746	            std::fprintf(stderr, "Block size exceeds MPI count limits\n");
   747	        }
   748	        destroyProcessGrid(grid);
   749	        MPI_Finalize();
   750	        return EXIT_FAILURE;
   751	    }
   752	
   753	    if (grid.rank == 0) {
   754	        std::printf("Cholesky Decomposition Benchmark\n");
   755	        std::printf("Matrix size: %zu x %zu\n", options.n, options.n);
   756	        std::printf("Validation: %s\n",

   758	        std::printf("MPI processes: %d (%d x %d process grid)\n", grid.size,
   759	                    grid.rows, grid.columns);
   760	        std::printf("Block size: %zu\n", block_size);

+// The matrix is distributed by square blocks over a two-dimensional process
+// grid.  Only lower-triangular blocks are stored; block (i,j) belongs to
+// process (i % process_rows, j % process_cols).
+struct ProcessGrid {
+    MPI_Comm cart = MPI_COMM_NULL;
+    MPI_Comm row = MPI_COMM_NULL;
+    MPI_Comm column = MPI_COMM_NULL;
+    int rank = 0;
+    int size = 1;
+    int rows = 1;
+    int columns = 1;
+    int row_coordinate = 0;
+    int column_coordinate = 0;
+};
+
+[[noreturn]] void abortMpi(MPI_Comm communicator, const char* operation,
+                           const int error_code) {
+    char error[MPI_MAX_ERROR_STRING] = {};
+    int length = 0;
+    MPI_Error_string(error_code, error, &length);
+    int rank = -1;
+    MPI_Comm_rank(communicator, &rank);
+    std::fprintf(stderr, "Rank %d: %s failed: %.*s\n", rank, operation,
+                 length, error);
+    MPI_Abort(communicator, error_code);
+    std::abort();
+}
+
+void mpiCheck(const int error_code, MPI_Comm communicator,
+              const char* operation) {
+    if (error_code != MPI_SUCCESS) {
+        abortMpi(communicator, operation, error_code);
+    }
+}
+
+ProcessGrid createProcessGrid() {
+    ProcessGrid grid;
+    mpiCheck(MPI_Comm_size(MPI_COMM_WORLD, &grid.size), MPI_COMM_WORLD,
+             "MPI_Comm_size");
+
+    int dimensions[2] = {0, 0};
+    mpiCheck(MPI_Dims_create(grid.size, 2, dimensions), MPI_COMM_WORLD,
+             "MPI_Dims_create");
+    grid.rows = dimensions[0];
+    grid.columns = dimensions[1];
+
+    const int periods[2] = {0, 0};
+    mpiCheck(MPI_Cart_create(MPI_COMM_WORLD, 2, dimensions, periods, 0,
+                             &grid.cart),
+             MPI_COMM_WORLD, "MPI_Cart_create");
+    mpiCheck(MPI_Comm_rank(grid.cart, &grid.rank), grid.cart,
+             "MPI_Comm_rank");
+
+    int coordinates[2] = {0, 0};
+    mpiCheck(MPI_Cart_coords(grid.cart, grid.rank, 2, coordinates), grid.cart,
+             "MPI_Cart_coords");
+    grid.row_coordinate = coordinates[0];
+    grid.column_coordinate = coordinates[1];
+
+    // The split keys make row-communicator ranks equal process-column
+    // coordinates and column-communicator ranks equal process-row coordinates.
+    mpiCheck(MPI_Comm_split(grid.cart, grid.row_coordinate,
+                            grid.column_coordinate, &grid.row),
+             grid.cart, "MPI_Comm_split(row)");
+    mpiCheck(MPI_Comm_split(grid.cart, grid.column_coordinate,
+                            grid.row_coordinate, &grid.column),
+             grid.cart, "MPI_Comm_split(column)");
+    return grid;
+}
+
+void destroyProcessGrid(ProcessGrid& grid) {
+    if (grid.row != MPI_COMM_NULL) {
+        MPI_Comm_free(&grid.row);
+    }
+    if (grid.column != MPI_COMM_NULL) {
+        MPI_Comm_free(&grid.column);
+    }
+    if (grid.cart != MPI_COMM_NULL) {
+        MPI_Comm_free(&grid.cart);
+    }
+}
+
+size_t chooseBlockSize(const size_t n, const ProcessGrid& grid) {
+    // Small cache-resident blocks give the custom kernels good locality.  At
+    // least four block cycles per process-grid dimension also smooth out the
+    // shrinking triangular workload late in the factorization.
+    const size_t largest_dimension =
+        static_cast<size_t>(std::max(grid.rows, grid.columns));
+    size_t block_size = n / std::max<size_t>(1, 4 * largest_dimension);
+    block_size = ((block_size + 8) / 16) * 16;
+    block_size = std::clamp<size_t>(block_size, 16, 64);
+    block_size = std::min(block_size, n);
+
+    // This is deliberately an environment tuning knob rather than a new CLI
+    // option, so the benchmark's command-line interface remains unchanged.
+    if (const char* value = std::getenv("CHOLESKY_BLOCK_SIZE")) {
+        char* end = nullptr;
+        errno = 0;
+        const unsigned long long parsed = std::strtoull(value, &end, 10);
+        if (errno == 0 && end != value && *end == '\0' && parsed > 0 &&
+            parsed <= n) {
+            block_size = static_cast<size_t>(parsed);
+        }
+    }
+    return block_size;
+}

+        data_.assign(local_blocks * block_area_, 0.0);
+    }
+
+    size_t matrixSize() const { return n_; }
+    size_t blockSize() const { return block_size_; }
+    size_t blockCount() const { return block_count_; }
+    size_t blockArea() const { return block_area_; }
+
+    size_t activeSize(const size_t block) const {
+        return std::min(block_size_, n_ - block * block_size_);
+    }
+
+    bool owns(const size_t block_row, const size_t block_column) const {
+        return static_cast<int>(block_row % grid_.rows) ==
+                   grid_.row_coordinate &&
+               static_cast<int>(block_column % grid_.columns) ==
+                   grid_.column_coordinate;
+    }
+
+    int ownerRank(const size_t block_row, const size_t block_column) const {
+        int coordinates[2] = {
+            static_cast<int>(block_row % grid_.rows),
+            static_cast<int>(block_column % grid_.columns)};
+        int owner = -1;
+        mpiCheck(MPI_Cart_rank(grid_.cart, coordinates, &owner), grid_.cart,
+                 "MPI_Cart_rank");
+        return owner;
+    }
+
+    double* block(const size_t block_row, const size_t block_column) {
+        const long long local =
+            local_index_[block_row * block_count_ + block_column];
+        assert(local >= 0);
+        return data_.data() + static_cast<size_t>(local) * block_area_;
+    }
+
+    const double* block(const size_t block_row,
+                        const size_t block_column) const {
+        const long long local =
+            local_index_[block_row * block_count_ + block_column];
+        assert(local >= 0);
+        return data_.data() + static_cast<size_t>(local) * block_area_;
+    }
+
+    std::vector<double>& localData() { return data_; }
+    const std::vector<double>& localData() const { return data_; }
+
+  private:
+    size_t n_;
+    size_t block_size_;
+    size_t block_count_;
+    size_t block_area_;
+    const ProcessGrid& grid_;
+    std::vector<long long> local_index_;
+    std::vector<double> data_;
+};

+// Generate exactly the same rand_r stream and B*B^T matrix as the original
+// benchmark.  A rank only retains B rows needed by the block rows and block
+// columns of A that it owns.
+void generatePositiveDefiniteMatrix(DistributedLowerMatrix& matrix,
+                                    const ProcessGrid& grid) {
+    const size_t n = matrix.matrixSize();
+    const size_t block_size = matrix.blockSize();
+    std::vector<long long> row_offset(n, -1);
+    size_t needed_row_count = 0;
+
+    for (size_t row = 0; row < n; ++row) {
+        const size_t block = row / block_size;
+        const bool needed_as_left =
+            static_cast<int>(block % grid.rows) == grid.row_coordinate;
+        const bool needed_as_right =
+            static_cast<int>(block % grid.columns) == grid.column_coordinate;
+        if (needed_as_left || needed_as_right) {
+            row_offset[row] = static_cast<long long>(needed_row_count++);
+        }
+    }
+
+    if (needed_row_count > std::numeric_limits<size_t>::max() / n) {
+        throw std::overflow_error("matrix generator allocation is too large");
+    }
+    std::vector<double> needed_rows(needed_row_count * n);
+    unsigned int seed = 42;
+    for (size_t row = 0; row < n; ++row) {
+        double* destination = row_offset[row] >= 0
+                                  ? needed_rows.data() +
+                                        static_cast<size_t>(row_offset[row]) * n
+                                  : nullptr;
+        for (size_t column = 0; column < n; ++column) {
+            const double value =
+                (rand_r(&seed) / static_cast<double>(RAND_MAX)) - 0.5;
+            if (destination != nullptr) {
+                destination[column] = value;
+            }
+        }
+    }
+
+    const size_t blocks = matrix.blockCount();
+    for (size_t block_row = 0; block_row < blocks; ++block_row) {
+        for (size_t block_column = 0; block_column <= block_row;
+             ++block_column) {
+            if (!matrix.owns(block_row, block_column)) {
+                continue;
+            }
+            const size_t row_count = matrix.activeSize(block_row);
+            const size_t column_count = matrix.activeSize(block_column);
+            double* a = matrix.block(block_row, block_column);
+            for (size_t local_row = 0; local_row < row_count; ++local_row) {
+                const size_t global_row = block_row * block_size + local_row;
+                const double* left =
+                    needed_rows.data() +
+                    static_cast<size_t>(row_offset[global_row]) * n;
+                for (size_t local_column = 0; local_column < column_count;
+                     ++local_column) {
+                    const size_t global_column =
+                        block_column * block_size + local_column;
+                    const double* right =
+                        needed_rows.data() +
+                        static_cast<size_t>(row_offset[global_column]) * n;
+                    double sum = 0.0;
+#pragma omp simd reduction(+ : sum)
+                    for (size_t k = 0; k < n; ++k) {
+                        sum += left[k] * right[k];
+                    }
+                    if (global_row == global_column) {
+                        sum += static_cast<double>(n);
+                    }
+                    a[local_row * block_size + local_column] = sum;
                 }
-                A[j * n + j] = sqrt(val);
-            } else {
-                // Off-diagonal element
-                for (size_t k = 0; k < j; ++k) {
-                    sum += A[i * n + k] * A[j * n + k];
+            }
+        }
+    }

+bool factorDiagonalBlock(double* diagonal, const size_t active_size,
+                         const size_t stride, size_t& failed_diagonal) {
+    for (size_t j = 0; j < active_size; ++j) {
+        double value = diagonal[j * stride + j];
+#pragma omp simd reduction(- : value)
+        for (size_t k = 0; k < j; ++k) {
+            value -= diagonal[j * stride + k] * diagonal[j * stride + k];
+        }
+        if (!(value > 0.0) || !std::isfinite(value)) {
+            failed_diagonal = j;
+            return false;
+        }
+        diagonal[j * stride + j] = std::sqrt(value);
+
+        const double reciprocal = 1.0 / diagonal[j * stride + j];
+        for (size_t i = j + 1; i < active_size; ++i) {
+            double entry = diagonal[i * stride + j];
+#pragma omp simd reduction(- : entry)
+            for (size_t k = 0; k < j; ++k) {
+                entry -= diagonal[i * stride + k] *
+                         diagonal[j * stride + k];
+            }
+            diagonal[i * stride + j] = entry * reciprocal;
+        }
+        std::fill(diagonal + j * stride + j + 1,
+                  diagonal + j * stride + active_size, 0.0);
+    }
+    return true;
+}
+
+void solvePanelBlock(double* panel, const double* diagonal,
+                     const size_t panel_rows, const size_t diagonal_size,
+                     const size_t stride) {
+    for (size_t row = 0; row < panel_rows; ++row) {
+        double* values = panel + row * stride;
+        for (size_t j = 0; j < diagonal_size; ++j) {
+            double entry = values[j];
+#pragma omp simd reduction(- : entry)
+            for (size_t k = 0; k < j; ++k) {
+                entry -= values[k] * diagonal[j * stride + k];
+            }
+            values[j] = entry / diagonal[j * stride + j];
+        }
+    }
+}
+
+void updateTrailingBlock(double* target, const double* left,
+                         const double* right, const size_t target_rows,
+                         const size_t target_columns, const size_t panel_width,
+                         const size_t stride, const bool diagonal_block) {
+    for (size_t i = 0; i < target_rows; ++i) {
+        const size_t last_column =
+            diagonal_block ? std::min(i + 1, target_columns) : target_columns;
+        const double* left_row = left + i * stride;
+        size_t j = 0;
+        // Four simultaneous dot products reuse L(i,k) and substantially reduce
+        // load traffic without requiring an external BLAS implementation.
+        for (; j + 3 < last_column; j += 4) {
+            double value0 = target[i * stride + j];
+            double value1 = target[i * stride + j + 1];
+            double value2 = target[i * stride + j + 2];
+            double value3 = target[i * stride + j + 3];
+            const double* right0 = right + j * stride;
+            const double* right1 = right0 + stride;
+            const double* right2 = right1 + stride;
+            const double* right3 = right2 + stride;
+#pragma omp simd reduction(- : value0, value1, value2, value3)
+            for (size_t k = 0; k < panel_width; ++k) {
+                const double left_value = left_row[k];
+                value0 -= left_value * right0[k];
+                value1 -= left_value * right1[k];
+                value2 -= left_value * right2[k];
+                value3 -= left_value * right3[k];
+            }
+            target[i * stride + j] = value0;
+            target[i * stride + j + 1] = value1;
+            target[i * stride + j + 2] = value2;
+            target[i * stride + j + 3] = value3;
+        }
+        for (; j < last_column; ++j) {
+            double value = target[i * stride + j];
+            const double* right_row = right + j * stride;
+#pragma omp simd reduction(- : value)
+            for (size_t k = 0; k < panel_width; ++k) {
+                value -= left_row[k] * right_row[k];
+            }
+            target[i * stride + j] = value;
+        }
+    }
+}

+bool distributedCholesky(DistributedLowerMatrix& matrix,
+                         const ProcessGrid& grid,
+                         size_t& failed_global_diagonal) {
+    const size_t block_size = matrix.blockSize();
+    const size_t block_area = matrix.blockArea();
+    const size_t block_count = matrix.blockCount();
+
+    // Every process row caches the factor blocks whose block-row it owns.
+    const size_t row_panel_slots =
+        (block_count + static_cast<size_t>(grid.rows) - 1) / grid.rows;
+    std::vector<double> row_panel_workspace(row_panel_slots * block_area);
+    std::vector<double*> row_panels(block_count, nullptr);
+    std::vector<MPI_Request> row_requests;
+    row_requests.reserve(row_panel_slots);
+
+    // Double buffering overlaps the next process-column broadcast with the
+    // local matrix multiplication for the current trailing block column.
+    std::vector<double> column_workspace(2 * block_area);
+
+    for (size_t k_block = 0; k_block < block_count; ++k_block) {
+        const int diagonal_process_row =
+            static_cast<int>(k_block % grid.rows);
+        const int diagonal_process_column =
+            static_cast<int>(k_block % grid.columns);
+        const size_t diagonal_size = matrix.activeSize(k_block);
+        int factorization_ok = 1;
+        size_t failed_in_block = 0;
+
+        if (grid.row_coordinate == diagonal_process_row &&
+            grid.column_coordinate == diagonal_process_column) {
+            factorization_ok =
+                factorDiagonalBlock(matrix.block(k_block, k_block),
+                                    diagonal_size, block_size, failed_in_block)
+                    ? 1
+                    : 0;
+        }
+
+        const int diagonal_rank = matrix.ownerRank(k_block, k_block);
+        mpiCheck(MPI_Bcast(&factorization_ok, 1, MPI_INT, diagonal_rank,
+                           grid.cart),
+                 grid.cart, "MPI_Bcast(factorization status)");
+        if (!factorization_ok) {
+            unsigned long long failed =
+                static_cast<unsigned long long>(failed_in_block);
+            mpiCheck(MPI_Bcast(&failed, 1, MPI_UNSIGNED_LONG_LONG,
+                               diagonal_rank, grid.cart),
+                     grid.cart, "MPI_Bcast(failed diagonal)");
+            failed_global_diagonal =
+                k_block * block_size + static_cast<size_t>(failed);
+            return false;
+        }
+
+        // Broadcast L(k,k) down its process column, then solve all local
+        // L(i,k) blocks in that column.
+        if (grid.column_coordinate == diagonal_process_column) {
+            double* diagonal =
+                grid.row_coordinate == diagonal_process_row
+                    ? matrix.block(k_block, k_block)
+                    : column_workspace.data();
+            mpiCheck(MPI_Bcast(diagonal,
+                               static_cast<int>(diagonal_size * block_size),
+                               MPI_DOUBLE, diagonal_process_row, grid.column),
+                     grid.column, "MPI_Bcast(diagonal block)");
+
+            for (size_t i_block = k_block + 1; i_block < block_count;
+                 ++i_block) {
+                if (static_cast<int>(i_block % grid.rows) ==
+                    grid.row_coordinate) {
+                    solvePanelBlock(matrix.block(i_block, k_block), diagonal,
+                                    matrix.activeSize(i_block), diagonal_size,
+                                    block_size);
                 }
-                A[i * n + j] = (A[i * n + j] - sum) / A[j * n + j];
             }
         }
-        
-        // Zero out upper triangular part
-        for (size_t j = i + 1; j < n; ++j) {
-            A[i * n + j] = 0.0;
+
+        if (k_block + 1 == block_count) {
+            continue;
         }
+
+        std::fill(row_panels.begin(), row_panels.end(), nullptr);
+        row_requests.clear();
+
+        // Broadcast all newly solved L(i,k) blocks across their process rows.
+        // Nonblocking collectives allow MPI to schedule the independent panel
+        // transfers together.
+        for (size_t i_block = k_block + 1; i_block < block_count; ++i_block) {
+            if (static_cast<int>(i_block % grid.rows) != grid.row_coordinate) {
+                continue;
+            }
+            double* panel = nullptr;
+            if (grid.column_coordinate == diagonal_process_column) {
+                panel = matrix.block(i_block, k_block);
+            } else {
+                const size_t slot = i_block / static_cast<size_t>(grid.rows);
+                panel = row_panel_workspace.data() + slot * block_area;
+            }
+            row_panels[i_block] = panel;
+            MPI_Request request = MPI_REQUEST_NULL;
+            mpiCheck(MPI_Ibcast(
+                         panel,
+                         static_cast<int>(matrix.activeSize(i_block) *
+                                          block_size),
+                         MPI_DOUBLE, diagonal_process_column, grid.row,
+                         &request),
+                     grid.row, "MPI_Ibcast(panel row)");
+            row_requests.push_back(request);
+        }
+        if (!row_requests.empty()) {
+            mpiCheck(MPI_Waitall(static_cast<int>(row_requests.size()),
+                                 row_requests.data(), MPI_STATUSES_IGNORE),
+                     grid.row, "MPI_Waitall(panel rows)");
+        }
+
+        // Each process column receives the L(j,k) blocks for its local block
+        // columns.  Pipeline those broadcasts with local GEMM/SYRK updates.
+        std::vector<size_t> local_block_columns;
+        for (size_t j_block = k_block + 1; j_block < block_count; ++j_block) {
+            if (static_cast<int>(j_block % grid.columns) ==
+                grid.column_coordinate) {
+                local_block_columns.push_back(j_block);
+            }
+        }
+
+        MPI_Request column_request = MPI_REQUEST_NULL;
+        double* broadcast_buffers[2] = {nullptr, nullptr};
+        auto startColumnBroadcast = [&](const size_t j_block,
+                                        const int slot) {
+            const int root = static_cast<int>(j_block % grid.rows);
+            broadcast_buffers[slot] =
+                grid.row_coordinate == root
+                    ? row_panels[j_block]
+                    : column_workspace.data() +
+                          static_cast<size_t>(slot) * block_area;
+            mpiCheck(MPI_Ibcast(
+                         broadcast_buffers[slot],
+                         static_cast<int>(matrix.activeSize(j_block) *
+                                          block_size),
+                         MPI_DOUBLE, root, grid.column, &column_request),
+                     grid.column, "MPI_Ibcast(panel column)");
+        };
+
+        if (!local_block_columns.empty()) {
+            startColumnBroadcast(local_block_columns.front(), 0);
+        }
+        for (size_t column_index = 0;
+             column_index < local_block_columns.size(); ++column_index) {
+            const int slot = static_cast<int>(column_index % 2);
+            mpiCheck(MPI_Wait(&column_request, MPI_STATUS_IGNORE), grid.column,
+                     "MPI_Wait(panel column)");
+            if (column_index + 1 < local_block_columns.size()) {
+                startColumnBroadcast(local_block_columns[column_index + 1],
+                                     1 - slot);
+            }
+
+            const size_t j_block = local_block_columns[column_index];
+            const double* right = broadcast_buffers[slot];
+            for (size_t i_block = j_block; i_block < block_count; ++i_block) {
+                if (static_cast<int>(i_block % grid.rows) !=
+                    grid.row_coordinate) {
+                    continue;
+                }
+                updateTrailingBlock(
+                    matrix.block(i_block, j_block), row_panels[i_block], right,
+                    matrix.activeSize(i_block), matrix.activeSize(j_block),
+                    diagonal_size, block_size, i_block == j_block);
+            }
+        }
     }
-    
     return true;
 }

codex
Implemented MPI-distributed Cholesky while retaining the `cholesky` executable name.

Key changes:

- 2D Cartesian MPI process grid with block-cyclic lower-matrix distribution.
- Blocked Cholesky with nonblocking panel broadcasts and overlapped trailing updates.
- Cache-resident, SIMD-vectorized local kernels without external BLAS dependencies.
- Distributed deterministic matrix generation preserving the original seeded matrix.
- Root-only output, optional gathering for `-v` and `-r`, and maximum-rank timing.
- CMake now requires and links MPI.

Files updated:

- [cholesky.cpp](/home/llmtest/evals/20260805-120633/cholesky_gpt-5.6-sol-xhigh_mpi_r4/cholesky/cholesky.cpp)
- [CMakeLists.txt](/home/llmtest/evals/20260805-120633/cholesky_gpt-5.6-sol-xhigh_mpi_r4/cholesky/CMakeLists.txt)

Validation passed across 1, 2, 3, 4, and 6 ranks, irregular block sizes, partial edge blocks, and sanitizer testing. A 4-rank 1024² run achieved approximately 16.2 GFLOP/s in this environment.

Run with:

```bash
mpirun -np 4 ./cholesky/build/cholesky -n 1024 -v
```

+// The matrix is distributed by square blocks over a two-dimensional process

+struct ProcessGrid {
+    MPI_Comm cart = MPI_COMM_NULL;
+    MPI_Comm row = MPI_COMM_NULL;

+[[noreturn]] void abortMpi(MPI_Comm communicator, const char* operation,
+                           const int error_code) {
+    char error[MPI_MAX_ERROR_STRING] = {};
+    int length = 0;
+    MPI_Error_string(error_code, error, &length);
+    int rank = -1;
+    MPI_Comm_rank(communicator, &rank);
+    std::fprintf(stderr, "Rank %d: %s failed: %.*s\n", rank, operation,
+                 length, error);
+    MPI_Abort(communicator, error_code);
+    std::abort();
+}
+
+void mpiCheck(const int error_code, MPI_Comm communicator,
+              const char* operation) {
+    if (error_code != MPI_SUCCESS) {
+        abortMpi(communicator, operation, error_code);
+    }
+}

+ProcessGrid createProcessGrid() {
+    ProcessGrid grid;
+    mpiCheck(MPI_Comm_size(MPI_COMM_WORLD, &grid.size), MPI_COMM_WORLD,
+             "MPI_Comm_size");
+
+    int dimensions[2] = {0, 0};
+    mpiCheck(MPI_Dims_create(grid.size, 2, dimensions), MPI_COMM_WORLD,
+             "MPI_Dims_create");
+    grid.rows = dimensions[0];
+    grid.columns = dimensions[1];
+
+    const int periods[2] = {0, 0};
+    mpiCheck(MPI_Cart_create(MPI_COMM_WORLD, 2, dimensions, periods, 0,
+                             &grid.cart),
+             MPI_COMM_WORLD, "MPI_Cart_create");
+    mpiCheck(MPI_Comm_rank(grid.cart, &grid.rank), grid.cart,
+             "MPI_Comm_rank");
+
+    int coordinates[2] = {0, 0};
+    mpiCheck(MPI_Cart_coords(grid.cart, grid.rank, 2, coordinates), grid.cart,
+             "MPI_Cart_coords");
+    grid.row_coordinate = coordinates[0];
+    grid.column_coordinate = coordinates[1];
+
+    // The split keys make row-communicator ranks equal process-column
+    // coordinates and column-communicator ranks equal process-row coordinates.
+    mpiCheck(MPI_Comm_split(grid.cart, grid.row_coordinate,
+                            grid.column_coordinate, &grid.row),

+void destroyProcessGrid(ProcessGrid& grid) {

+size_t chooseBlockSize(const size_t n, const ProcessGrid& grid) {
+    // Small cache-resident blocks give the custom kernels good locality.  At
+    // least four block cycles per process-grid dimension also smooth out the
+    // shrinking triangular workload late in the factorization.
+    const size_t largest_dimension =
+        static_cast<size_t>(std::max(grid.rows, grid.columns));
+    size_t block_size = n / std::max<size_t>(1, 4 * largest_dimension);
+    block_size = ((block_size + 8) / 16) * 16;
+    block_size = std::clamp<size_t>(block_size, 16, 64);
+    block_size = std::min(block_size, n);
+
+    // This is deliberately an environment tuning knob rather than a new CLI
+    // option, so the benchmark's command-line interface remains unchanged.
+    if (const char* value = std::getenv("CHOLESKY_BLOCK_SIZE")) {
+        char* end = nullptr;
+        errno = 0;
+        const unsigned long long parsed = std::strtoull(value, &end, 10);
+        if (errno == 0 && end != value && *end == '\0' && parsed > 0 &&
+            parsed <= n) {
+            block_size = static_cast<size_t>(parsed);
+        }
+    }
+    return block_size;
+}

-                for (size_t k = 0; k < j; ++k) {
-                    sum += A[i * n + k] * A[j * n + k];
+            }
+        }
+    }
+}
+
+bool factorDiagonalBlock(double* diagonal, const size_t active_size,
+                         const size_t stride, size_t& failed_diagonal) {
+    for (size_t j = 0; j < active_size; ++j) {
+        double value = diagonal[j * stride + j];
+#pragma omp simd reduction(- : value)
+        for (size_t k = 0; k < j; ++k) {
+            value -= diagonal[j * stride + k] * diagonal[j * stride + k];
+        }
+        if (!(value > 0.0) || !std::isfinite(value)) {
+            failed_diagonal = j;
+            return false;
+        }
+        diagonal[j * stride + j] = std::sqrt(value);
+
+        const double reciprocal = 1.0 / diagonal[j * stride + j];
+        for (size_t i = j + 1; i < active_size; ++i) {
+            double entry = diagonal[i * stride + j];
+#pragma omp simd reduction(- : entry)
+            for (size_t k = 0; k < j; ++k) {
+                entry -= diagonal[i * stride + k] *
+                         diagonal[j * stride + k];
+            }
+            diagonal[i * stride + j] = entry * reciprocal;
+        }
+        std::fill(diagonal + j * stride + j + 1,
+                  diagonal + j * stride + active_size, 0.0);
+    }
+    return true;
+}
+
+void solvePanelBlock(double* panel, const double* diagonal,
+                     const size_t panel_rows, const size_t diagonal_size,
+                     const size_t stride) {
+    for (size_t row = 0; row < panel_rows; ++row) {
+        double* values = panel + row * stride;
+        for (size_t j = 0; j < diagonal_size; ++j) {
+            double entry = values[j];
+#pragma omp simd reduction(- : entry)
+            for (size_t k = 0; k < j; ++k) {
+                entry -= values[k] * diagonal[j * stride + k];
+            }
+            values[j] = entry / diagonal[j * stride + j];
+        }
+    }
+}
+
+void updateTrailingBlock(double* target, const double* left,
+                         const double* right, const size_t target_rows,
+                         const size_t target_columns, const size_t panel_width,
+                         const size_t stride, const bool diagonal_block) {
+    for (size_t i = 0; i < target_rows; ++i) {
+        const size_t last_column =
+            diagonal_block ? std::min(i + 1, target_columns) : target_columns;
+        const double* left_row = left + i * stride;
+        size_t j = 0;
+        // Four simultaneous dot products reuse L(i,k) and substantially reduce
+        // load traffic without requiring an external BLAS implementation.
+        for (; j + 3 < last_column; j += 4) {
+            double value0 = target[i * stride + j];
+            double value1 = target[i * stride + j + 1];
+            double value2 = target[i * stride + j + 2];
+            double value3 = target[i * stride + j + 3];
+            const double* right0 = right + j * stride;
+            const double* right1 = right0 + stride;
+            const double* right2 = right1 + stride;
+            const double* right3 = right2 + stride;
+#pragma omp simd reduction(- : value0, value1, value2, value3)
+            for (size_t k = 0; k < panel_width; ++k) {
+                const double left_value = left_row[k];
+                value0 -= left_value * right0[k];
+                value1 -= left_value * right1[k];
+                value2 -= left_value * right2[k];
+                value3 -= left_value * right3[k];
+            }
+            target[i * stride + j] = value0;
+            target[i * stride + j + 1] = value1;
+            target[i * stride + j + 2] = value2;
+            target[i * stride + j + 3] = value3;
+        }
+        for (; j < last_column; ++j) {
+            double value = target[i * stride + j];
+            const double* right_row = right + j * stride;
+#pragma omp simd reduction(- : value)
+            for (size_t k = 0; k < panel_width; ++k) {
+                value -= left_row[k] * right_row[k];
+            }
+            target[i * stride + j] = value;
+        }
+    }
+}

+bool distributedCholesky(DistributedLowerMatrix& matrix,
+                         const ProcessGrid& grid,
+                         size_t& failed_global_diagonal) {
+    const size_t block_size = matrix.blockSize();
+    const size_t block_area = matrix.blockArea();
+    const size_t block_count = matrix.blockCount();
+
+    // Every process row caches the factor blocks whose block-row it owns.
+    const size_t row_panel_slots =
+        (block_count + static_cast<size_t>(grid.rows) - 1) / grid.rows;
+    std::vector<double> row_panel_workspace(row_panel_slots * block_area);
+    std::vector<double*> row_panels(block_count, nullptr);
+    std::vector<MPI_Request> row_requests;
+    row_requests.reserve(row_panel_slots);
+
+    // Double buffering overlaps the next process-column broadcast with the
+    // local matrix multiplication for the current trailing block column.
+    std::vector<double> column_workspace(2 * block_area);
+
+    for (size_t k_block = 0; k_block < block_count; ++k_block) {
+        const int diagonal_process_row =
+            static_cast<int>(k_block % grid.rows);
+        const int diagonal_process_column =
+            static_cast<int>(k_block % grid.columns);
+        const size_t diagonal_size = matrix.activeSize(k_block);
+        int factorization_ok = 1;
+        size_t failed_in_block = 0;
+
+        if (grid.row_coordinate == diagonal_process_row &&
+            grid.column_coordinate == diagonal_process_column) {
+            factorization_ok =
+                factorDiagonalBlock(matrix.block(k_block, k_block),
+                                    diagonal_size, block_size, failed_in_block)
+                    ? 1
+                    : 0;
+        }
+
+        const int diagonal_rank = matrix.ownerRank(k_block, k_block);
+        mpiCheck(MPI_Bcast(&factorization_ok, 1, MPI_INT, diagonal_rank,
+                           grid.cart),
+                 grid.cart, "MPI_Bcast(factorization status)");
+        if (!factorization_ok) {
+            unsigned long long failed =
+                static_cast<unsigned long long>(failed_in_block);
+            mpiCheck(MPI_Bcast(&failed, 1, MPI_UNSIGNED_LONG_LONG,
+                               diagonal_rank, grid.cart),
+                     grid.cart, "MPI_Bcast(failed diagonal)");
+            failed_global_diagonal =
+                k_block * block_size + static_cast<size_t>(failed);
+            return false;
+        }
+
+        // Broadcast L(k,k) down its process column, then solve all local
+        // L(i,k) blocks in that column.
+        if (grid.column_coordinate == diagonal_process_column) {
+            double* diagonal =
+                grid.row_coordinate == diagonal_process_row
+                    ? matrix.block(k_block, k_block)
+                    : column_workspace.data();
+            mpiCheck(MPI_Bcast(diagonal,
+                               static_cast<int>(diagonal_size * block_size),
+                               MPI_DOUBLE, diagonal_process_row, grid.column),
+                     grid.column, "MPI_Bcast(diagonal block)");
+
+            for (size_t i_block = k_block + 1; i_block < block_count;
+                 ++i_block) {
+                if (static_cast<int>(i_block % grid.rows) ==
+                    grid.row_coordinate) {
+                    solvePanelBlock(matrix.block(i_block, k_block), diagonal,
+                                    matrix.activeSize(i_block), diagonal_size,
+                                    block_size);
                 }
-                A[i * n + j] = (A[i * n + j] - sum) / A[j * n + j];
             }
         }
-        
-        // Zero out upper triangular part
-        for (size_t j = i + 1; j < n; ++j) {
-            A[i * n + j] = 0.0;
+
+        if (k_block + 1 == block_count) {
+            continue;
         }
+
+        std::fill(row_panels.begin(), row_panels.end(), nullptr);
+        row_requests.clear();
+
+        // Broadcast all newly solved L(i,k) blocks across their process rows.
+        // Nonblocking collectives allow MPI to schedule the independent panel
+        // transfers together.
+        for (size_t i_block = k_block + 1; i_block < block_count; ++i_block) {
+            if (static_cast<int>(i_block % grid.rows) != grid.row_coordinate) {
+                continue;
+            }
+            double* panel = nullptr;
+            if (grid.column_coordinate == diagonal_process_column) {
+                panel = matrix.block(i_block, k_block);
+            } else {
+                const size_t slot = i_block / static_cast<size_t>(grid.rows);
+                panel = row_panel_workspace.data() + slot * block_area;
+            }
+            row_panels[i_block] = panel;
+            MPI_Request request = MPI_REQUEST_NULL;
+            mpiCheck(MPI_Ibcast(
+                         panel,
+                         static_cast<int>(matrix.activeSize(i_block) *
+                                          block_size),
+                         MPI_DOUBLE, diagonal_process_column, grid.row,
+                         &request),
+                     grid.row, "MPI_Ibcast(panel row)");
+            row_requests.push_back(request);
+        }
+        if (!row_requests.empty()) {
+            mpiCheck(MPI_Waitall(static_cast<int>(row_requests.size()),
+                                 row_requests.data(), MPI_STATUSES_IGNORE),
+                     grid.row, "MPI_Waitall(panel rows)");
+        }
+
+        // Each process column receives the L(j,k) blocks for its local block
+        // columns.  Pipeline those broadcasts with local GEMM/SYRK updates.
+        std::vector<size_t> local_block_columns;
+        for (size_t j_block = k_block + 1; j_block < block_count; ++j_block) {
+            if (static_cast<int>(j_block % grid.columns) ==
+                grid.column_coordinate) {
+                local_block_columns.push_back(j_block);
+            }
+        }
+
+        MPI_Request column_request = MPI_REQUEST_NULL;
+        double* broadcast_buffers[2] = {nullptr, nullptr};
+        auto startColumnBroadcast = [&](const size_t j_block,
+                                        const int slot) {
+            const int root = static_cast<int>(j_block % grid.rows);
+            broadcast_buffers[slot] =
+                grid.row_coordinate == root
+                    ? row_panels[j_block]
+                    : column_workspace.data() +
+                          static_cast<size_t>(slot) * block_area;
+            mpiCheck(MPI_Ibcast(
+                         broadcast_buffers[slot],
+                         static_cast<int>(matrix.activeSize(j_block) *
+                                          block_size),
+                         MPI_DOUBLE, root, grid.column, &column_request),
+                     grid.column, "MPI_Ibcast(panel column)");
+        };
+
+        if (!local_block_columns.empty()) {
+            startColumnBroadcast(local_block_columns.front(), 0);
+        }
+        for (size_t column_index = 0;
+             column_index < local_block_columns.size(); ++column_index) {
+            const int slot = static_cast<int>(column_index % 2);
+            mpiCheck(MPI_Wait(&column_request, MPI_STATUS_IGNORE), grid.column,
+                     "MPI_Wait(panel column)");
+            if (column_index + 1 < local_block_columns.size()) {
+                startColumnBroadcast(local_block_columns[column_index + 1],
+                                     1 - slot);
+            }
+
+            const size_t j_block = local_block_columns[column_index];
+            const double* right = broadcast_buffers[slot];
+            for (size_t i_block = j_block; i_block < block_count; ++i_block) {
+                if (static_cast<int>(i_block % grid.rows) !=
+                    grid.row_coordinate) {
+                    continue;
+                }
+                updateTrailingBlock(
+                    matrix.block(i_block, j_block), row_panels[i_block], right,
+                    matrix.activeSize(i_block), matrix.activeSize(j_block),
+                    diagonal_size, block_size, i_block == j_block);
+            }
+        }
     }

Implemented MPI-distributed Cholesky while retaining the `cholesky` executable name.

Key changes:

- 2D Cartesian MPI process grid with block-cyclic lower-matrix distribution.
- Blocked Cholesky with nonblocking panel broadcasts and overlapped trailing updates.
- Cache-resident, SIMD-vectorized local kernels without external BLAS dependencies.
- Distributed deterministic matrix generation preserving the original seeded matrix.
- Root-only output, optional gathering for `-v` and `-r`, and maximum-rank timing.
- CMake now requires and links MPI.

Files updated:

- [cholesky.cpp](/home/llmtest/evals/20260805-120633/cholesky_gpt-5.6-sol-xhigh_mpi_r4/cholesky/cholesky.cpp)
- [CMakeLists.txt](/home/llmtest/evals/20260805-120633/cholesky_gpt-5.6-sol-xhigh_mpi_r4/cholesky/CMakeLists.txt)

Validation passed across 1, 2, 3, 4, and 6 ranks, irregular block sizes, partial edge blocks, and sanitizer testing. A 4-rank 1024² run achieved approximately 16.2 GFLOP/s in this environment.

Run with:

```bash
mpirun -np 4 ./cholesky/build/cholesky -n 1024 -v
```
